correctness.rationale: A bijection between rooted forests and uniformly chosen parent-label sequences of length n-m-1 establishes the entire conditional factorial-moment law. An exact conditional-on-origin restriction establishes the negative covariance for all n≥2. The strict mean difference is algebraic; a uniform logarithmic Taylor expansion on the Rayleigh window and Rayleigh survival tail plus dominated convergence establish the sharp covariance constant. No infinite result rests on 200 finite exact verification checks.

value.rationale: The dependence between two central mapping observables (cyclic recurrent vertices and zero-indegree transient origins) is mathematically natural.
